descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-05 Keeping Data Secure / Real-PHI Readiness Gate · S07 「provider 报告和子处理方清单：代码能连到的每个供应商，带账号、区域和托管，有文档、有日期、有负责人」 Provider report and subprocessor list: every vendor the code can reach, with account, region and hosting, documented, dated and owned

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • T4 Engineering reports which providers and services are actually in use, and under which account and hosting setup, so this can be checked against what the BAAs cover.（TFA-92568 AC 7；TFA-92568 Eng 6） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress
  • U6 The subprocessor list and the hosting arrangement are documented and kept current as a record.（UAT OAT-05；TFA-92568 AC 11；TFA-92568 Product 4） — gate: blocked: TFA-92568 in progress

测试设计方法：主流程（happy-path） — 照 UAT / 票的原话把正常流程走一遍，该出现的都要出现。

Given The code at the UAT commit, the production config (aiProvider row, Convex env names, Pulumi stack outputs), the documented subprocessor list and hosting arrangement (location per Q11), and the consent screen list

When Tim and Quinn write the provider report: for each provider and service, what data it receives, from which function, and under which account, org or project, and region. Then compare the documented subprocessor list with the report entry by entry, and check that it is dated, names an owner and states the hosting arrang …

Then The report lists at least: Convex (backend and hosting); AWS Bedrock Claude Haiku 4.5 and Mistral Large 3 (account, region, guardrail); OpenAI gpt-live-transcribe and whisper-1, and OpenAI text only if the row can select it (org); Google Vertex Gemini (project, location); AWS SES (sign-in code, no PHI). …

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-92568 AC 7 and Eng 6; UAT OAT-05 step 6 and TFA-92568 AC 11 and Product 4. A vendor or service the code can send data to that the report leaves out, or a vendor without its account or project, is a Fail. A missing list, a reported vendor missing from the list, or no date or owner is a Fail. …

在哪跑：本地 code-review（读代码判）；测试方法 DOC · 文档核对；矩阵里排的车道 人工（manual）

S07 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-05.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane code-review。

测试方法：DOC · 文档核对；辅助：CODEREVIEW · 代码审查 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：code-review。
